STOP_SPRING_source_dependency.explicit_offset_or_allocation_branch: product_assembly.native_scene overrides each side when allocation is not None or dq or dx; evaluates q=cam.K*slide_mm+dq.

source_defined_independent_input_domain.KEY_and_crosshead_offsets: Independent side pairs (dq,dx) subject to abs(dx)<=(G-R)*hypot(1,K)+TOL and abs(dx-dq)<=(G-R)*sqrt(2)+TOL.
source_defined_independent_input_domain.profile_restriction: For both contacts on each side, every q=K*slide+dq must lie in [0,12]; no clamping.
source_defined_independent_input_domain.nominal_telescope_choice: When unspecified, three equal .1+(8.2-descent)/3 values per side; source explicitly says not physically enforced.
source_defined_independent_input_domain.OPEN_accessories: Hold/support flags Boolean; either true requires slide==79.75 and descent==8.2.
